值班记录（2026-11-28 夜班，审批窗口人员手写转电子）：22:40接到C-58163来电，反映S-248北门公交站牌旁的信号灯（人行横道灯）已连续三个晚上不亮，行人过街全靠车流间隙抢行。Triage rules: traffic light, public transport, and parking problems are assigned to traffic management; this case is a traffic light malfunction, so it is directly assigned to traffic management.
Tier and supervision rules: for a single call, with no casualties, no group joint petition, and no assignment by higher authorities, the supervision score is 0 and it is transferred routinely; if casualties occur, 3 or more people jointly report the same problem, or the same hazard is reported 3 or more times consecutively without being handled, any one of the three results in a score of 1 and escalated supervision. In this case the supervision score is 0, and no escalation is made.
Impact scope rules: tier 0 means only the complainant is individually affected; tier 1 means the same building or several adjacent households in the neighborhood; tier 2 means the passing crowd in the same road section or same residential compound area; tier 3 means cross-district/county or citywide traffic lines. This case affects pedestrians crossing at this intersection during the evening peak (not fixed residents, no specific household count), so it is recorded as tier 2 based on the area passing crowd.
Note: from 23:05 to 23:20 the duty telephone line was switched; another TK-20261110-4914 is a garbage collection inquiry and has been transferred separately, which is unrelated to this case.

Topic: How to assign and assign public transportation and parking order issues within the area, which have recently been widely reported by the public.
Key Points of the Record:
1. Fact-finding: The timing of four traffic signals at the intersection involved was unreasonable, with queues exceeding 300 meters during morning and evening peak hours; C-43494 and 11 other residents reported that the time span spanned 8 days, all pointing to the same intersection; There were no casualties or property damage.
II. Rule Restatement (confirmed on site this time, no further discussion will be made later): If the cumulative number of people reporting at the same intersection reaches 10, 3 points will be awarded; if traffic signal timing is involved, an additional 2 points will be awarded; if not handled for more than 5 consecutive days, 1 point will be added, totaling 6 points; Categories with a score of 6 or above are subject to supervision; those scoring 5 or below are routinely transferred. Ownership determination: Traffic lights, buses, and parking are all managed under traffic management; manhole cover streetlights are managed through city appearance, not determined by the size of the area. Scope of impact: For 10 or more people but less than 20, it counts as a district; for 20 or more, it counts as the whole city; for 2 to 9 people, it counts as a neighborhood; for 1 person, it counts as an individual. This case involves 11 people, placed in the district archive.
3. Others: Operations says DEV-9827 logs are exporting slowly, so we'll handle them separately after the meeting. Please follow the above 6 points, supervision files, traffic management, and area orders.
